source.external_runtime: cellrank 2.0.x + palantir 1.4.x Python packages supplied by the host; prior columns produced by the two prerequisite skills

required_semantics: h5ad whose obs carries the two prior columns (Palantir pseudotime increasing along differentiation; CytoTRACE2_Score higher = less differentiated), aligned by cell_id
raw-count provenance for the graph build (the entrypoint re-runs normalize_total + palantir log2 + HVG + PCA internally)

blockers: Verified on mouse pancreas (2850 cells) and paul15 myeloid (2730 cells) with the pinned environment; not numerically locked across cellrank/palantir releases.
Fate probabilities are model-conditional quantities, not measured transition rates; the audits catch anchor/numeric/selection failures, not biological validity.
Auto eigengap state selection can collapse to n=1 on CytoTRACE2-weighted kernels even when the fixed-K model is healthy; the primary model must use explicit n_states.
The built-in CytoTRACEKernel is unusable on restricted gene panels and on log-transformed data; this skill deliberately excludes it and fuses external scores instead.
Direction-conflict rates near 0.5 with near-zero rank correlation were observed on both validation datasets; per-sample conflict auditing requires a sample column the validation data lacks.
